name: gpdoc-chatgpt-hosted
description: Edit, review, import and export Markdown in ChatGPT on web, desktop and mobile.

interface.longDescription: Open and import Markdown, text, HTML and Word files into the shared GPEditor. Edit with themes, variables, comments and tracked suggestions. Export PDF, HTML, Word, Markdown and LaTeX with progress and downloadable links. Sign in to save account documents, connect open drafts to chat review, share, collaborate live, use cloud providers and publish to GitHub Pages. Device imports create editable copies; Save does not overwrite the original device file. Host-opened files retain host-owned saving. Platform capabilities are checked at runtime.
defaultPrompt: Open this Markdown file in GPEditor
